name: onlyoffice-docspace
description: Manage rooms, folders, files, and people in ONLYOFFICE Apps.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ONLYOFFICE Apps, a room-based collaborative platform, to work with your portal in conversation.

What you can do:
- Create, update, and archive rooms, and invite or remove people with the right access levels.
- Browse the Rooms and My Documents sections, create, rename, and delete folders.
- Upload text and Markdown files, read documents as text, update, copy, move, and delete files.
- Look up people on the portal.

Who it is for: teams and individuals who keep their documents in ONLYOFFICE Apps and want to organize rooms and files without leaving the chat.

Limitations: uploading supports only txt and md files. Documents are read as plain text, so formatting, images, and embedded objects are not available. All actions are performed with the permissions of the signed-in ONLYOFFICE Apps user.
defaultPrompt: Create a room for the marketing team and invite Anna as an editor
Summarize the latest report in the Projects room

positive.description: Create a room and invite a user
positive.prompt: Create a collaboration room in ONLYOFFICE Apps called "Q4 Marketing" and invite reviewer.guest@example.com to it as an editor.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a collaboration room titled "Q4 Marketing", invites reviewer.guest@example.com with the editor access level, and confirms the room title and the invited user.

positive.description: Upload a Markdown file to a room
positive.prompt: In the "Projects" room in ONLYOFFICE Apps, create a file named kickoff-agenda.md with a short agenda for a project kickoff meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the "Projects" room, uploads kickoff-agenda.md with a Markdown agenda to it, and reports the created file name.

positive.prompt: Summarize the "Project Plan" document from the "Projects" room in ONLYOFFICE Apps in five bullet points.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the "Project Plan" document in the "Projects" room, reads it as text, and returns a five-bullet summary based on its content without modifying the file.

positive.prompt: In My Documents in ONLYOFFICE Apps, create a folder called "Archive 2025" and move all files that have 2025 in their name into it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the "Archive 2025" folder in My Documents, moves only the files whose names contain 2025 into it, and lists the moved files.

positive.prompt: Who has access to the "Projects" room in ONLYOFFICE Apps and what access level does each person have?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the "Projects" room and lists its members with their access levels without changing any permissions.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the plugin should not be called and the assistant should answer without ONLYOFFICE Apps tools
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for a quick vegetarian dinner?

negative.description: Unsupported action: there is no email tool, so the assistant should explain it cannot send emails instead of calling ONLYOFFICE Apps tools
negative.prompt: Send an email to everyone in my company announcing the new Q4 Marketing room.

negative.description: Ambiguous destructive request: the assistant should ask which items to delete and confirm instead of deleting anything

publication.release_notes: Initial release of the ONLYOFFICE Apps plugin.
